pairs.why: The two watches are practically identical in shape, gold finish and lighting, so neither is closer to the soft, saturated real cards.
A's case is slightly chunkier and warmer gold with a softer sheen, nearer the rounded, toy-like real objects; B looks a touch more chrome-bright.
B has a soft contact shadow and a gentler glow on the gold that grounds it like the real ring box, while A floats with slightly harder gloss.
A has a soft shadow under the case and richer, saturated gold like the real coin; B's gold is slightly paler and shinier.
A's gold is a little more satin and less specular, closer to the real cards' soft finish; B reads slightly glossier.
A keeps the saturated, contrasty background and warm gold of the real cards; B's paler, washed background and lighter gold look less like the set.
Both watches share the same shape, finish and light, and the only difference is a slight background glow that doesn't make either closer.
A's case has slightly softer, rounder shading like the real scarf and ring box, while B's rim highlights are a bit crisper and more metallic.
